## About
Chams Electrical Services installs electric car charging stations at homes, apartments, condominiums, workplaces and retail locations around Houston. We're a certified Tesla charger installer, and we also handle residential wiring, commercial work and appliance installation.
Our approach is simple: work safely, follow the installation requirements, and leave a clean job behind. We never cut corners or take shortcuts.
Customers rate us 4.9 from 361 Google reviews. Call or request a quote and tell us what your project needs.

## Services
- Tesla Charger Installation: Tesla Wall Connector and EV charger installs at your home, apartment, condo, work or retail location, done by a certified Tesla charger installer.
- All major charger brands: Beyond Tesla, we install chargers from Ford, Rivian, BMW, Emporia, Clipper Creek and Grizzle.
- Residential: We'll come to your house and handle your wiring needs.
- Commercial: Solutions built around how your business runs, with an estimate up front so you can plan around your budget.
- New Installation: New appliances, or old ones that need to be re-installed, put in properly from the start.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Request a free quote through our site or call us. One reviewer sent pictures online and had a quote within a few hours.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Saturday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Sunday.

Q: Do I need to be home for the install?
A: One reviewer said they didn't need to be home while we installed their EV charger. Let us know your situation when you book.

Q: Do you only install EV chargers?
A: No. We handle residential and commercial electrical work and appliance installation too.
